body:
An agent asked for permission to write to a "protected file" but its question was a general ask rather than a proposed change in the proper format for the human to allow a change:

May I add Solace commands for `bun test` and `bun build src/main.mjs --outfile priv/app.js --minify --target browser` to the protected solace.toml, then run the JavaScript tests and rebuild the browser bundle?

Answer: You're supposed to edit the solace.toml in the board's directory, not at the root.
title: Agents guided to use proper question workflow
